Standard TL Features Technology Package
• 280-hp, 3.5-liter, 24-valve, SOHC VTEC® V-6 engine (Available for TL and TL SH-AWD)
• 6-speed automatic transmission with sport mode and Sequential SportShift paddle shifters • Acura Navigation System with Voice Recognition™
• Front-wheel drive • Acura/ELS Surround® Premium Audio System with hard disk drive
• 4-wheel independent suspension: double wishbone front / multi-link rear (HDD) media storage and 10 speakers
• Electric variable power-assisted rack-and-pinion steering (EPS) • Song By Voice®
• 17-inch aluminum-alloy wheels, P245/50 R17 98V high-performance all-season tires • AcuraLink Real-Time Traffic and Weather™3
• Dual-zone, dual-mode adaptive climate control system • Traffic Rerouting™3
• Remote entry system with Acura personalized settings • Rearview camera
• Bluetooth® HandsFreeLink® telephone interface7 • Keyless Access System with smart entry, pushbutton ignition and Acura personalized settings
• Leather-trimmed interior • GPS-linked, solar-sensing, dual-zone, dual-mode adaptive climate control system
• Driver’s and front passenger’s heated, power-adjustable seats • Perforated Milano Premium Leather-trimmed interior
• Acura Premium Sound System 8 speakers, including 8-inch subwoofer
• USB Audio Interface with iPod® integration4 Advance Package
• Bluetooth Audio7 (Includes Technology Package)
• Power moonroof with tilt feature
• Blind-spot information system (BSI)
• Auto-on/off xenon high-intensity discharge (HID) headlights
• Ventilated and heated front seats
• Fog lights
• Aluminum-alloy wheels and tires size increase: TL to 18-inch; TL SH-AWD to 19-inch,
P245/40 R19 94W high-performance all-season tires

Safety • EPA Passenger Volume 98.2 cu ft

• Wheelbase 109.3 in / Length 194.0 in / Height 57.2 in / Width 74.0 in
• Vehicle Stability Assist™ (VSA®) with traction control
• 4-wheel anti-lock braking system (ABS) with Electronic Brake Distribution (EBD) and Brake Assist
• Dual-stage, multiple-threshold front airbags (SRS), front side airbags and side curtain airbags
